inputs.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a static medium close-up shot from a slightly high eye-level angle opens on the young woman with long silver-white hair and fluffy white cat ears shown in <Picture 1>, wearing a black low-cut square-neck velvet top, a black choker, and a silver flower pendant, holding a smartphone as she takes a selfie in a softly lit indoor room with gray floral curtains and a patterned rug behind her. She looks into the camera with clear, innocent eyes, her fluffy white tail resting on the rug, her cat ears relaxed. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward her face as she slowly lowers the phone and sets it aside, her gaze turning from pure to dazed and seductive; she hooks a fingertip under her choker and tugs it gently, then slides her other hand down to the neckline of her velvet top, pulling the fabric lower to bare her shoulders and collarbone, revealing the deep valley of her cleavage. She lowers one hand to the rug behind her, arches her back, and begins to rock her hips in a slow riding motion, her waist rolling in small, sensual circles, her cat ears twitching, her chest rising and falling with quick breaths.Her lips part and her jaw drops, and the young woman with a soft, breathy, seductive voice (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] ……主人，想被我骑吗？</d> Her jaw resets at the end of the line, her nostrils flaring slightly as she takes a breath, and the frame holds on her flushed, pleading gaze as she continues the slow roll of her hips.
